changelog:
Initial release of the Product × Engineering × Operations alignment SOP playbook.

- Provides a dual-layer Kanban system for unified backlog and sprint planning.
- Standardizes a 10-day sprint cadence with tri-party alignment checkpoints.
- Introduces issue templates with reproducibility and severity rules (auto-escalation after 3 reports).
- Defines veto power for operations on releases (P0 bugs can block shipping).
- Includes ready-to-use meeting and responsibility templates.
- Multilingual documentation (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean).
summary: 🇺🇸 Your dev team ships features nobody asked for while user-reported bugs pile up for months. Operations blames engineering for ignoring users; engineering...
